meta.description: Security contact and vulnerability reporting policy for Uha.

page.title: Security
page.intro: Found a security issue in Uha? Report it privately so I can investigate.
page.reporting_body: Email mail@uha.app with the affected URL or app area, steps to reproduce the issue, and its impact. Share only the information needed to demonstrate it; leave out credentials and other people’s data.
page.scope_body: Reports can cover the Uha iOS app, uha.app, its public discovery endpoints, and services operated for Uha. Social engineering, spam, denial-of-service testing, and attacks on third-party services are out of scope.
page.policy_body: Please allow time to investigate and fix the issue before publishing details. There is no paid bug bounty. I appreciate responsible reports and credit researchers when appropriate.
